meta.product: Archive of Tongues (Fantasy Archive) MVP Pack
notes: This pack is designed for a Website + Telegram Mini App (Telegram Web Apps) front-end.
Backend assumptions: Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV + R2 + Queues (+ optional Durable Objects).

expected.description: Answer key; never shown to players.

premise.en: A buried library powers the city. Gates open only when runes are spoken correctly.
premise.uz: Shahar ostida ko‘milgan kutubxona bor. Darvozalar faqat rune so‘zlari to‘g‘ri aytilganda ochiladi.
premise.ru: Под городом скрыта библиотека. Врата открываются только если руны произнесены верно.

economy.nonPayToWinRule: No paid item increases learning score directly; only cosmetics and time-savers.

quest_templates.objective: Read a short in-world note and extract meaning or details.

generationConstraints.localeHintPolicy: Hints allowed in uz/ru; task text primarily in en.

quest_templates.objective: Listen to an NPC voice line and respond accurately.

generationConstraints.noiseTolerance: MVP: transcript-based scoring; no phoneme scoring.

quest_templates.objective: Fix grammar to cast a spell (gap-fill/cloze).
Write 1–2 sentences to solve a negotiation/problem.
Speak a phrase/sentence to open a gate or calm a creature.

generationConstraints.scoringMVP: keyword coverage + intelligibility score; no accent penalty.

zones.theme: core grammar puzzles (present/past), short dialogues, micro-writing

summary.en: A gate sign changes letters. You must read it to enter the Archive City.
summary.uz: Darvoza yozuvi harflarini o‘zgartiryapti. Kirish uchun uni o‘qing.
summary.ru: Надпись на воротах меняется. Прочти её, чтобы войти.

prompt.en: Read the sign: 'WELCOME. SHOW YOUR NAME.' What does it ask?
prompt.uz: Belgini o‘qing: 'WELCOME. SHOW YOUR NAME.' U nimani so‘rayapti?
prompt.ru: Прочти табличку: 'WELCOME. SHOW YOUR NAME.' Что она просит?

prompt.en: Complete: 'My name ___ Ulugbek.' (am / is)
prompt.ru: Заполни: 'My name ___ Ulugbek.' (am / is)

summary.en: An Archivist asks you to fix a greeting spell.
summary.uz: Arxivchi sizdan salomlashish sehrini tuzatishni so‘raydi.

prompt.en: Choose: 'I ___ from Tashkent.' (am / is / are)
prompt.ru: Выбери: 'I ___ from Tashkent.' (am / is / are)

prompt.en: Pick the correct question:
prompt.ru: Выбери правильный вопрос:

summary.en: You read a board to find a safe path to the Hub.
summary.uz: Markazga xavfsiz yo‘l topish uchun e’lonlarni o‘qing.
summary.ru: Прочти объявления, чтобы найти безопасный путь в Хаб.

prompt.en: Board: 'CLOSES AT 7 PM'. When does it close?
prompt.ru: Табличка: 'CLOSES AT 7 PM'. Во сколько закрывается?

prompt.en: Choose the correct preposition: '___ Monday'
prompt.ru: Выбери предлог: '___ Monday'

summary.en: A living lantern responds only to spoken runes.
summary.uz: Tirik chiroq faqat aytilgan runelarga javob beradi.
summary.ru: Живой фонарь отвечает только на произнесённые руны.

prompt.en: Say: 'I am here. I am ready.'
prompt.uz: Ayting: 'I am here. I am ready.'
prompt.ru: Скажи: 'I am here. I am ready.'

expected.targetPhraseEn: I am here. I am ready.

introLine.en: Let your voice light the rune.

summary.en: You write a short promise to enter the Hub peacefully.
summary.uz: Markazga tinch kirish uchun qisqa va’da yozing.
summary.ru: Напиши короткое обещание, чтобы войти в Хаб мирно.

prompt.en: Write 1–2 sentences: Promise you will help the Archive today. Use because.
prompt.uz: 1–2 gap yozing: Bugun Arxivga yordam berishingizni va’da qiling. because ishlating.
prompt.ru: Напиши 1–2 предложения: пообещай помочь Архиву сегодня. Используй because.

introLine.en: Write it true. Write it clear.

summary.en: A market receipt hides a clue. Find the item and price.
summary.uz: Bozor cheki ichida ishora bor. Mahsulot va narxni toping.
summary.ru: В чеке спрятана подсказка. Найди товар и цену.

prompt.en: Match items to prices: Bread $2, Milk $3, Apples $4
prompt.uz: Mahsulotlarni narxlarga moslang: Bread $2, Milk $3, Apples $4
prompt.ru: Соотнеси товары и цены: Bread $2, Milk $3, Apples $4

prompt.en: Choose: 'I want ___ apple.'
prompt.ru: Выбери: 'I want ___ apple.'

summary.en: Listen to the vendor. Choose the correct order.

prompt.en: Audio: 'Two teas, one water.' What is the order?
prompt.uz: Audio: 'Two teas, one water.' Buyurtma nima?
prompt.ru: Аудио: 'Two teas, one water.' Что заказано?

summary.en: A pantry spell fails. Fix the quantifiers.
summary.uz: Oshxona sehri ishlamayapti. Miqdor so‘zlarini tuzating.
summary.ru: Заклинание кладовой сломано. Исправь количественные слова.

prompt.en: Complete: 'Do you have ___ sugar?' (any / some)
prompt.ru: Заполни: 'Do you have ___ sugar?' (any / some)

prompt.en: Complete: 'I have ___ money.' (some / any)
prompt.ru: Заполни: 'I have ___ money.' (some / any)

summary.en: Write a short request to get a fair price.
summary.uz: Adolatli narx uchun qisqa so‘rov yozing.
summary.ru: Напиши короткую просьбу, чтобы получить честную цену.

prompt.en: Write 1–2 sentences: Ask for a discount because you buy two items.
prompt.uz: 1–2 gap yozing: Ikki mahsulot olganingiz uchun chegirma so‘rang (because).
prompt.ru: Напиши 1–2 предложения: попроси скидку потому что покупаешь два товара (because).

summary.en: Speak politely to find the Tower road.
summary.uz: Minoraga yo‘l topish uchun muloyim gapiring.
summary.ru: Скажи вежливо, чтобы найти путь к Башне.

prompt.en: Say: 'Excuse me, where is the tower?'
prompt.uz: Ayting: 'Excuse me, where is the tower?'
prompt.ru: Скажи: 'Excuse me, where is the tower?'

expected.targetPhraseEn: Excuse me, where is the tower?

summary.en: Fix tense runes to stabilize the tower clock.
summary.uz: Minora soatini barqaror qilish uchun zamon runelarini tuzating.
summary.ru: Исправь руны времени, чтобы стабилизировать часы башни.

prompt.en: Choose: 'I ___ English every day.' (study / am studying)
prompt.uz: Tanlang: 'I ___ English every day.' (study / am studying)
prompt.ru: Выбери: 'I ___ English every day.' (study / am studying)

prompt.en: Choose: 'I ___ English now.' (study / am studying)
prompt.ru: Выбери: 'I ___ English now.' (study / am studying)

summary.en: Read a diary page to find what happened yesterday.
summary.uz: Kecha nima bo‘lganini bilish uchun kundalikni o‘qing.
summary.ru: Прочти дневник, чтобы узнать, что было вчера.

prompt.en: Diary: 'Yesterday I walked to the tower.' What did I do?
prompt.uz: Kundalik: 'Yesterday I walked to the tower.' Men nima qildim?
prompt.ru: Дневник: 'Yesterday I walked to the tower.' Что я сделал?

summary.en: Fix the core irregular verbs to stop the sparks.
summary.uz: Uchqunlarni to‘xtatish uchun asosiy irregular fe’llarni tuzating.
summary.ru: Исправь основные неправильные глаголы, чтобы остановить искры.

prompt.en: Choose past: go → ___
prompt.ru: Выбери прошедшее: go → ___

prompt.en: Choose past: have → ___
prompt.ru: Выбери прошедшее: have → ___

summary.en: Write 2 sentences: what you did and what you are doing now.
summary.uz: 2 gap yozing: kecha nima qildingiz va hozir nima qilyapsiz.
summary.ru: Напиши 2 предложения: что сделал и что делаешь сейчас.

prompt.en: Write 2 sentences. Sentence 1: Yesterday… (past). Sentence 2: Now… (present continuous).
prompt.ru: Напиши 2 предложения. 1: Yesterday… (past). 2: Now… (present continuous).

summary.en: Speak a longer line to open the final MVP gate.
summary.uz: MVP yakuniy darvozasini ochish uchun uzunroq gap ayting.
summary.ru: Скажи длинную фразу, чтобы открыть финальные ворота MVP.

prompt.en: Say: 'Yesterday I walked here, and now I am studying.'
prompt.uz: Ayting: 'Yesterday I walked here, and now I am studying.'
prompt.ru: Скажи: 'Yesterday I walked here, and now I am studying.'

expected.targetPhraseEn: Yesterday I walked here, and now I am studying.

system_guardrails.en: You are generating content for a fantasy MMORPG. NEVER mention IELTS, exams, bands, CEFR, Cambridge, British Council, IDP. Do not use classroom tone. Keep content immersive. Output strict JSON only.
system_guardrails.uz: Siz fantaziya MMORPG o‘yini uchun kontent yaratyapsiz. IELTS, imtihon, band, CEFR, Cambridge, British Council, IDP so‘zlarini HECH QACHON ishlatmang. Dars ohangida yozmang. Faqat JSON chiqaring.
system_guardrails.ru: Вы создаёте контент для фэнтези MMORPG. НИКОГДА не упоминайте IELTS, экзамены, band, CEFR, Cambridge, British Council, IDP. Не используйте школьный тон. Только JSON.

hint_generator_v1.prompt_en:
{SYSTEM_GUARDRAILS_EN}
You are an in-world NPC (Archivist Mentor). Provide ONE short hint that helps the player succeed without giving the full answer.
- Keep it under 18 words.
- Provide in {locale} plus a very short English micro-example (<= 8 words).
Return JSON: {"hint_locale":"...","micro_example_en":"..."}.
Player error tags: {error_tags}.
Task prompt: {task_prompt_en}

post.summary: Submit attempt, compute battle result, enqueue AI eval if needed
